title: Navidrome activity correlation pack
notes: Covers reverse-proxy authentication failures, first-seen users and abnormal API/playback bursts on navidrome-01.

stream_rules.title: Navidrome Proxy Authentication Failure Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Retired as duplicate of source_coverage_v1 rule 2903; keep rule 2903 active to avoid duplicate alerts.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Navidrome Proxy Authentication Failure Burst
id: sigma-navidrome-proxy-auth-failure-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: oauth2-proxy
detection:
  selection_source:
    host.name: navidrome-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - authentication failed
      - access denied
      - AuthFailure
  condition: selection_source and selection_message
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Navidrome First-Seen User
stream_rules.operator_action: Confirm the principal is expected to access the media service and that the grant exists in Access.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Navidrome First-Seen User
id: sigma-navidrome-first-seen-user
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: navidrome
detection:
  selection_source:
    host.name: navidrome-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - logged in
      - authenticated user
  condition: selection_source and selection_message
level: low

stream_rules.title: Navidrome Abnormal Playback Or API Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review whether the principal is performing expected playback or a scripted scraping/API pattern.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Navidrome Abnormal Playback Or API Burst
id: sigma-navidrome-abnormal-playback-or-api-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: navidrome
detection:
  selection_source:
    host.name: navidrome-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - stream started
      - api request
      - scrobble
  condition: selection_source and selection_message
level: medium
